August is here, and the $50 off AirPods Pro 3, $100 off AirPods Max 2, and AirTag 2 at all-time low prices are still going strong. But the main event in today's 9to5Toys midday flash is the M5 MacBook Air — we're tracking a rare $200 price drop on the 24GB/512GB model alongside official Apple Certified Refurbished Store price drops of up to $300 on select configurations, including this 24GB 15-inch model (more details via this link). Those deals join nearly $100 in savings across multiple Apple Watch Ultra 3 configurations, the latest Beats 240W Woven USB-C Cable in black down at $18, plus the Beats Solo Buds in transparent red dropping to as low as $40. More details below.

Apple Certified Refurbished Store now has the lowest prices on M5 MacBook Air with up to $300 off

The latest MacBook lineup price hikes have officially hit retail, and while we've tracked plenty of deals with up to $500 off, the official Apple Certified Refurbished Store is offering the best deals on select M5 MacBook Air configurations. We've previously featured the lowest prices on the base model from a reputable source, but you can also score the 24GB 15-inch model in Midnight, Silver, Starlight, and Sky Blue at $300 off the new pricing over at that storefront.

The official Apple Certified Refurbished Store is selling the 15-inch M5 MacBook Pro with 24GB of RAM and 1TB of storage for $1,699 with free shipping. As mentioned above, the offer applies across all four colors: Midnight, Silver, Starlight, and Sky Blue.

This is a $1,900 MacBook Air that currently goes for over $1,999 in every configuration on Amazon.

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB $1,099 (originally $1,299 new) — $200 off
  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB $1,359 (originally $1,599 new) — $240 off
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB $1,699 (originally $1,999 new) — $300 off

Today's Apple refurb deal drops this machine back to its older pricing, delivering the largest discount we've tracked since the price increase. Looking at the current state of things, these new MSRPs are here to stay through the end of the year and beyond. So while this isn't the all-time low price we've tracked, it's a solid money-saving opportunity for anyone looking to get in on the M5 MacBook Air lineup this year — the next-generation MacBook Air isn't likely to see prices like this until 2027.

Browse all MacBook deals at the Apple Certified Refurbished Store now — use the filters on the left side of the page to narrow down to your preferred model.

The cheapest 24GB 15-inch M5 MacBook Air sees $200 price drop today

Ongoing: Amazon today offers first-ever $500 price drop on 2TB M5 Pro MacBook Pro

MacBook prices just went up, but Amazon this morning still has up to $500 off the 24GB/2TB M5 Pro MacBook Pro. That's very close to the best price we tracked before the price increase. Details below.

Amazon is now selling the 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro with 24GB of RAM and 2TB of storage for $2,499 with free shipping.

Considering this machine regularly retails for $2,999 at Apple and elsewhere, that's a solid $500 in savings. The deal applies to Space Black and Silver models.

This is the best deal we've tracked on M5 Pro models since retailers hiked prices.

Prior to this, Amazon's deepest discount on this machine was $300, but it's now been dropped by another $200.

That's still not as low as the price we tracked for this configuration before the official price increase, but there's no helping it — prices simply can't go back in time. All things considered, and remembering that this machine saw a significant price hike roughly a month ago, this deal lands just $100 above the all-time low price we've tracked on this M5 Pro.

Black and Natural Titanium Apple Watch Ultra 3 models see nearly $100 price drop at Amazon

Update: As we suspected, Amazon has also dropped prices on several other Ultra 3 configurations, including the Natural Titanium model with the Anchor Blue Ocean Band, by nearly $100. Details below.

While Series 11 deals have been steadily rolling out, as we saw at the start of August, discounts on the Apple Watch Ultra 3 have been harder to come by. But this morning we spotted Amazon dropping the price of the black Ultra 3 with the black One-Size Ocean Band by nearly $100.

Amazon is now selling the black titanium Apple Watch Ultra 3 with the matching Black Ocean Band for $699.99 with free shipping.

That's nearly $100 off the $799 retail price, making it the best deal we've found from a reputable retailer on a brand new unit.

Aside from a brief Amazon Prime Day deal at $150 off, this offer matches the best deal of the year and is one of the few times we've seen a major discount from Amazon.

At the time of writing, the black model with the Ocean Band is the only configuration seeing a notable discount. But if this deal follows the pattern of the last one, we'll likely see more colors discounted today and throughout the week.

  • Black Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Black Ocean Band $700 (originally $799)
  • Natural Titanium Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Anchor Blue Ocean Band $700 (originally $799)
  • Natural Titanium Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Blue Trail Loop $700 (originally $799)
  • Natural Titanium Apple Watch Ultra 3 with Milanese Loop $800 (originally $899)

If you're after the Series 11, you can grab one right now for well below that price:

  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 $299 (originally $399)
  • 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 $329 (originally $429)

Latest Beats 240W Woven USB-C Cable in black drops back to $18 with free shipping for Prime members, new all-time low (40% off)

Grab the transparent red Beats Solo Buds for as low as $41

We're impressed with the Solo Buds' built-in battery life — this is the most affordable current-generation Beats wireless earbuds you can buy. But they retail for $80, and typically go for around $70 on Amazon, so grabbing them from Best Buy for $41 with free shipping is an even more attractive proposition. Browse all Best Buy Beats deals now, and keep reading for more details on this Solo Buds deal.

Best Buy is selling the transparent red version of the Beats Solo Buds in "excellent" open-box condition for $40.99 with free shipping. That's nearly half off the suggested retail price, and far less than the $70 you'd spend on a brand new pair on Amazon.

  • Functionality and appearance like new.
  • Includes all parts and accessories. Packaging may be different or missing.

It's certainly a more entry-level pair of earbuds, but they're still current-generation earbuds from Apple for just $41.

As mentioned above, we confirmed in our review that the earbuds' built-in battery delivers up to 18 hours of listening time on a single charge. While it doesn't come with a battery-equipped wireless charging case, that's plenty for most users, especially at $41. Other features include "seamless one-touch pairing," a custom microphone with "advanced noise-learning algorithm" for superior call quality, and industry-leading Class 1 Bluetooth.
